headline: The Pakistan Meteorological Department said on Wednesday that light rain and drizzle are expected at isolated places in Karachi on Friday, The Express Tribune reports.

card.desc: Isolated drizzle expected; most of Sindh stays dry and cool.

caption:
Light rain likely in Karachi this Friday!
According to The Express Tribune, the Pakistan Meteorological Department (PMD) said on Wednesday that light rain and drizzle are expected at isolated places in Karachi on Friday. A westerly wave may also bring light rain to Dadu, Kamber Shahdadkot, Jamshoro and Thatta. Karachi's maximum temperature will stay between 32 and 34°C over the next three days. Most of Sindh will stay dry, with cool nights and misty mornings.
